newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Dragon says finds new nickel zone.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Dragon says finds new nickel zone.

text.p: Dragon Mining NL said on Wedsnesday that exploration work confirmed the presence of nickel at the Weld Range mine prospect in Western Australia.
Testing of a three km zone within an eight km by 400 metre nickel-enriched laterite identified last year at Weld Range revealed a broad mineralised envelope up to 60 metres thick, Dragon said.
The grading of the ore was above 0.5 percent nickel, including several intersections of greater than 1.00 percent and a top grade of 2.45 percent nickel, Dragon said.
Dragon said that while the results were significant, it was too early to seriously consider a development project.
The Weld Range prospect is 35 percent owned by Dragon and 65 percent by Sons of Gwalia Ltd.
